info.name: Metro API smoke
info.description: BE-18B smoke collection for health and authentication. Runtime tokens stay in collection variables.

item.name: Reports — Admin (BE-15)
item.description: Use a dedicated test environment and set adminAccessToken from an Admin account with ACTIVE operator membership; this collection does not create or seed that account. Set passengerAccessToken separately for the 403 check. reportLineId/reportTicketProductId must belong to the Admin's operator. Each successful export writes an audit and report job; retries create additional records. Dates are inclusive UTC+7, maximum 31 days. paymentStatus filters collections only, not refunds. Use current-value variables for tokens; do not export credentials.

exec: if (pm.response.code === 200) { const b = pm.response.json(); pm.test('Revenue contract and net cashflow', () => { pm.expect(b.timezone).to.eql('Asia/Ho_Chi_Minh'); pm.expect(b).to.have.all.keys('from','to','timezone','dataAsOf','totals','rows'); pm.expect(b.totals.netCashflowMinor).to.eql(b.totals.actualCollectedMinor - b.totals.successfulRefundMinor); }); }

request.description: Payment totals use the payment's frozen order version. Successful refunds use succeeded_at; pending refunds are requests created in the range with a currently unresolved status, not an end-of-period balance.

exec: if (pm.response.code === 200) { const b = pm.response.json(); pm.test('Ticket pagination and totals', () => { pm.expect(b.page).to.eql(1); pm.expect(b.pageSize).to.eql(50); pm.expect(b.totals).to.have.property('readyTicketCount'); pm.expect(b.totals).to.have.property('pendingIssuanceTicketCount'); }); }

request.description: Filters ticket issued_at. READY is ready; PENDING and NEEDS_SUPPORT are pending. CANCELLED counts as neither; missing jobs return UNAVAILABLE. Defaults: page=1, pageSize=50, maximum pageSize=100.
Returns UTF-8 CSV and records REPORT_EXPORT audit data. purpose is required; never put personal data in it.
Requires fixture IDs for the authenticated operator. Line is the last suggestion at payment success, not an actual ride. Compare with exported CSV using the same filters.

exec: pm.test('READY filter returns only READY rows', () => { pm.response.to.have.status(200); pm.response.json().rows.forEach(r => pm.expect(r.issuanceStatus).to.eql('READY')); });

exec: pm.test('Pagination contract', () => { pm.response.to.have.status(200); const b=pm.response.json(); pm.expect(b.page).to.eql(2); pm.expect(b.pageSize).to.eql(1); pm.expect(b.rows.length).to.be.at.most(1); });

item.name: Booking (BE-07)
item.description: BE-07 / SRS v1.2 UC11, UC36, UC39. Use buyer JWT; switch to recipient JWT for ordinary consent. CHILD_UNDER_6 requires approved guardianship and a paid guardian ticket for that route/date. Suggestions never hold capacity. Empty bookingRequestKey generates a fresh request key; set it explicitly to replay a write.

request.description: BE-08 must first supply a verified final no-charge outcome. Reconfirm Checkout after content/price changes. At most 3 attempts per order; repeated retry for one prior attempt returns its same successor.

item.name: Service Operations (BE-14)
item.description: BE-14 requires an active operator membership and Admin JWT for mutations/history. Fill current trip/station/operator variables. ETA/load dates must match the trip service date. For replay keep both operationsRequestKey and all body values (including observed time) fixed. Suggestions use the 15-second BE-07 worker; no holds or automatic refunds. EMAIL_MOCK is an outbox only.

item.name: Gate validation (BE-10)
item.description: Active StationStaff/Admin JWT and matching operator membership required. Use current raw BE-09 QR payloads; never save secrets or real passenger QR in the collection. Empty gateRequestId generates a UUID. Keep it fixed with exactly the same body when replaying; clear it before a different action. Copy the source scan UUID into gateSourceRequestId for resolution. Pending (202) grants no passage. PairPresentConfirmed is required for both entry and exit of guardian-child pairs. UC18 verified QR display/replacement is in the QR support subfolder; OTP is never returned in HTTP.

item.name: Entry (keep requestId and body unchanged for retry)

QR support (UC18)
item.description: Use a StationStaff/Admin JWT. Provide the ticket holder name/date of birth. Separate operationId (pending action) from requestId (one attempt). Keep IDs/body fixed for network retries. For a different OTP attempt or proof method clear gateQrAccessRequestId; keep operationId/action/reason fixed. To start another support action clear all three QR request/operation variables. Enter the code received at the holder email in gateQrEmailCode; it is never auto-read from an API response. For DOCUMENT, verify the illustrative document against the profile and record a private evidence reference. Set gateQrAction=DISPLAY to preserve the credential or REPLACE to retire it atomically. READY is not gate permission. Do not save real secrets/identity data into the shared collection.

Verify documented identity when email is inaccessible

Recover access result before retrying a replacement

exec: for (const key of ['gateQrOperationId','gateQrChallengeRequestId','gateQrAccessRequestId']) if (!pm.collectionVariables.get(key)) pm.collectionVariables.set(key, pm.variables.replaceIn('{{$guid}}'));

if ([200,202].includes(pm.response.code) && !pm.response.headers.get('Content-Type').includes('image/png')) { const result=pm.response.json(); if(result.challengeId) pm.collectionVariables.set('gateQrChallengeId',result.challengeId); pm.test('No OTP or token exposed',()=>{pm.expect(result).not.to.have.property('emailCode');pm.expect(result).not.to.have.property('qrToken');}); }
